description: Source code for the DeviceArtDescriptor class, which manages device frame images (background, shadow, reflection) for screenshots in Android development tools.

classes.name: DeviceArtDescriptor
classes.description: Manages device frame resources (background, shadow, reflection) for different device orientations.

classes.name: DeviceArtDescriptor.OrientationData
classes.description: Holds data for a specific device orientation, including image files, size, position, and crop info.

methods.name: getDescriptors
methods.description: Loads device art descriptors from resource XML files.

methods.name: getArtDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves orientation-specific data for a given screen orientation.

methods.name: getScreenSize
methods.description: Returns the screen size for a specified orientation.

methods.name: getScreenPos
methods.description: Returns the screen position for a specified orientation.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the frame size for a specified orientation.

methods.name: getCrop
methods.description: Returns the crop rectangle for a specified orientation.

methods.name: canFrameImage
methods.description: Determines if an image can be framed with this device descriptor based on aspect ratio and stretchability.
